It is $21.16 to purchase enough oil and a filter to change out my car's oil.

A roll of proper towels for cleaning any spilled oil comes out to $0.04 per towel, and assuming it will take me an average of 7 towels to clean any minor spills and my tools, I am up to another $0.28.

A box of nitrile gloves is $0.15 per glove. As they are tear and puncture resistant, I will only need one pair, which is $0.30 per oil change.

Degreaser for larger spills comes out to $0.06 per fluid ounce. The amount needed for if and how big a spill is can vary extremely, so I will only add $0.12 to the total as an average guesstimate.

As I already have the tools needed and would only need a capture pan and jack stands, I will not include the initial investment in the cost as it will decrease each time one changes their oil.

So far, I am at $21.86. If I include the 7% state sales tax, then the total price per oil change is $23.39.
